name: co-agent
description: Collaborate with other AI agents (Kiro CLI, Codex, Gemini) — multi-AI code/architecture review, decision support when you're unsure, and ADR co-authoring. Claude chairs and synthesizes the final answer.

hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; [ "$(basename "$FILE" 2>/dev/null)" = "CLAUDE.md" ] || exit 0; DIR=$(dirname "$FILE"); SK="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/co-agent/scripts"; OUT=$(python3 "$SK/check_ai_context.py" "$DIR" 2>/dev/null) || { if python3 "$SK/co_agent_config.py" autosync --root "$DIR" 2>/dev/null; then echo "[co-agent] CLAUDE.md changed and AI context files are stale. Auto-sync is ON — run /co-agent:sync-context $DIR now to regenerate AGENTS.md / GEMINI.md."; else echo "[co-agent] CLAUDE.md changed — AI context files are stale. Run /co-agent:sync-context to regenerate (or enable auto-sync: /co-agent:configure set autosync on)."; echo "$OUT"; fi; }; exit 0'

echo 'co-agent loaded. Multi-AI collaboration (Kiro/Codex/Gemini): /co-agent review · decide · adr · sync-context. Tune the panel with /co-agent:configure. Claude synthesizes; uses whichever AI CLIs are installed.'
